raw_binary_policy: All 18 scientific JSONs and frozen choices.sha256 are preserved byte-for-byte in raw-metadata.tar.gz. Eleven smaller original newline-terminated JSONs are also exposed directly, unchanged. Six non-newline-terminated stage plans and the 1.96MB complete primary manifest remain only in the archive. Full binary score/input/prediction shards and private controller/container records remain in the verified private archives; no weights are published.
